title: Treasury user blocked with AADSTS50079 after phone replacement (no MFA method left)
narrative: The user's old phone was the only Authenticator registration and was wiped. Sign-in now fails with AADSTS50079. The service desk must verify identity out of band (call back on the HR-record number, manager confirmation) before issuing a one-time Temporary Access Pass; resetting MFA on a caller's word is the social-engineering path this control exists to stop.

auditEvidence.source: Ticket: identity verified by call-back, TAP issued, passkey registered (synthetic)
